propositions: Core command handlers currently parse argv imperatively without shared argparse definitions, creating duplicated grammar across ticket, store, read/write, config, import/export, maintenance, and gate commands.
Each core command's runtime handler must route through a single S2a argparse factory wired to its Route.parser_factory field in _registry.py, eliminating parallel imperative parsing logic.
Per-family unknown-token semantics (skip via parse_known_args vs reject-with-exit-2) must be preserved during migration, verified by negative tests covering each family's pre-migration behavior.

Router-level global flags (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) are extracted pre-factory in _cli/__init__.py; per-command factories parse only the command-local tail and do not re-declare globals.

Parser factories must not import domain executors or optional dependencies, and real selected execution must resolve no unrelated parser factory or handler, proven by construction-exclusion and dispatch-isolation assertions.
